title: Claude Mythos / Capybara — Next-Generation Anthropic Model (Testing Phase)
description: Anthropic's upcoming model, internally called 'Claude Mythos' (codenamed Capybara), was revealed via an accidental content management leak on March 27, 2026. Anthropic confirmed it is in testing and described as a 'step change in capabilities' — their most capable model to date. Leaked materials indicate significant outperformance of Opus 4.6 on coding, academic reasoning, and cybersecurity benchmarks. Currently available to select early access customers. Represents a new model tier above the current Opus series.

routing.reason: Model is in testing phase with limited early access. No GA release date confirmed. Integration is impossible until public availability.
routing.when_to_revisit: When Anthropic announces GA availability — monitor anthropic.com/news and Claude Code changelog.
